verses.1: The fruit of Israel is abundant; it’s too much for its purpose. It’s suitable for worshiping God. It’s a good thing for the land. Its conditions are excellent.
verses.2: Now their hearts will be filled with sorrow; they will be destroyed from their idols. They will be freed from their captivity.
verses.3: For now, they will say, “There is no king for us, because we do not fear the LORD. What will the king do to us?”
verses.4: They spoke those words that were meant to break the covenant. They were like flowers that bloomed from the judgment upon the students of Shadai.
verses.5: In the houses of Aven, Shkhan Shmoron will be confined. For his people and his kings will find him in a state of disgrace, as if he has been banished from us.
verses.6: And also, for Ashur, it was a gift to the king Yerav Bashna. Ephraim will take it and divide it among the Israelites according to his will.
verses.7: It seems that Shomron’s king is like a thorn on the surface of the sea.
verses.8: And they shall be destroyed by the death of their sins. The people of Israel will be scattered and will fall upon their idols. They will say, “May we be like the mountains that have been destroyed, and may we fall upon us!”
verses.9: From the time of the conquest, Israel sinned. There, they stood without being able to cross the border against the children of Amorah.
verses.10: In my anger, I will destroy them; nations will gather against them to fight against each other.
verses.11: And Ephraim is like a pregnant woman. I love her deeply. I will go over to her good side. Ephraim will be saved by Yehuda. Yaakov will save her.
verses.12: Let justice be your seed; let righteousness be your foundation. May God bless you, and may justice reign over you until His coming.
verses.13: You have become evil; your days are short. You eat the fruits of deceitfulness, because you trusted in your own ways, despite all your power and authority.
verses.14: And Kām Shāon will be destroyed in your land, and all your enemies will be destroyed, just as Shalman destroyed the house of Arbel on the day of battle. Or maybe it’s related to children who were killed in that battle.
verses.15: Thus he made for you the House of God, in order to protect you from your enemies during those difficult times. This was a sign from the King of Israel.
